cases.name: Shelli Waltemath
cases.about: On a Facebook post, Jamie Ackerson wrote: "Shellie Waltmathe was one of those people who left an impression without ever having to try. She was a genuinely good person who never seemed to have a bad thing to say about anyone. She had the most infectious smile, the most random dance moves, and a laugh that could be heard across the room."
